decision_status_reason: The client has specified the material (petroleum stream), the measurement quantity (water content), and the desire for a fiber-based measurement closer to the process. This supports a provisional assessment for in-line spectroscopy methods.

stated: The client handles a petroleum stream.
Samples are currently sent to a laboratory for water determination.
The client wants to investigate a fiber-based measurement closer to the process.
The analyzer would be outside the process area.

unknowns.item: Specific type of fiber-optic spectroscopy to be used
unknowns.why_it_matters: Different types of spectroscopy (e.g., NIR, Raman) have different capabilities and limitations for detecting water content.

unknowns.item: Exact location and environmental conditions of the analyzer
unknowns.why_it_matters: Environmental conditions can affect the performance and durability of the equipment.

unknowns.item: Required sensitivity and accuracy for water detection
unknowns.why_it_matters: Determines the specifications needed for the equipment to meet process requirements.
Ensures compatibility and seamless operation with current process controls.

assumptions: The client is looking for real-time or near real-time water content measurement.
The fiber-optic measurement system will be used to detect changes in water content more quickly than the current laboratory method.

clarification_questions.question: What is the required sensitivity and accuracy for water detection in the petroleum stream?
What are the environmental conditions at the analyzer's location?
Are there specific integration requirements with existing systems?
What is the expected range of water content in the petroleum stream?
Is there a preferred type of spectroscopy (e.g., NIR, Raman) already considered?

recommendations.rationale: MIR-ATR spectroscopy is effective for detecting water content in petroleum, as shown by its use in similar applications.
recommendations.applies_when: The petroleum stream can be accessed for ATR probe insertion and the water content is within the detectable range of MIR.

citations.supports: ATR probes with ZrO2 tips can be used for water content measurement in petroleum.

recommendations.rationale: NIR spectroscopy is commonly used for online analysis and can detect water content through transmission or transflection probes.
recommendations.applies_when: The petroleum stream is suitable for NIR transmission or transflection measurements.

citations.supports: NIR spectroscopy allows for online applications, including remote measurements via fiber optic probes.

measurement_concept.summary: The measurement will likely involve an ATR probe for MIR spectroscopy or a transmission/transflection probe for NIR spectroscopy, with the analyzer located outside the process area.
measurement_concept.fiber_link_note: The fiber link will need to be defined based on the chosen method and environmental conditions.

citations.supports: ATR probes with ZrO2 tips can be used for water content measurement in petroleum.
NIR spectroscopy allows for online applications, including remote measurements via fiber optic probes.

spectral_range.note: MIR-ATR is effective for detecting water content in petroleum streams.

spectral_range.note: NIR spectroscopy is suitable for detecting water content through transmission or transflection.

risks.risk: Environmental conditions may affect probe performance.
risks.mitigation: Select probes and fibers rated for the specific environmental conditions.

citations.supports: NIR spectroscopy allows for online applications, including remote measurements via fiber optic probes.

risks.risk: Integration with existing systems may be complex.
risks.mitigation: Conduct a detailed integration study to ensure compatibility.

feasibility_plan.objective: To establish the feasibility of in-line water content measurement in petroleum using fiber-optic spectroscopy.
samples_or_process_states: Petroleum stream with varying water content.
comparisons: Compare MIR-ATR and NIR methods for water detection.
steps: Define the environmental conditions and integration requirements.
Select appropriate probes and fibers for MIR-ATR and NIR.
Conduct initial tests to compare sensitivity and accuracy against laboratory results.
feasibility_plan.go_no_go_basis: The method must demonstrate comparable or superior sensitivity and accuracy to the current laboratory method.
